This page details the installation and usage of the .NET version of the PropLib implementation of the IF-77 Electromagnetic Wave propagation model.

{{< include /includes/_link_to_model_home.qmd >}}

## Installation

This .NET package is distributed on 
[NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/ITS.Propagation.IF77).

There are two easy ways to install the NuGet package: [dotnet CLI](#installation-with-dotnet-cli) or [Visual Studio](#installation-with-visual-studio).

### Installation with dotnet CLI

1. Run the following command to install the package.

    ```default
    dotnet add package ITS.Propagation.IF77
    ```

1. After the command completes, open the project csproj file to see the added NuGet package reference:

    ```default
    <ItemGroup>
        <PackageReference Include="ITS.Propagation.IF77" Version="1.1.0" />
    </ItemGroup>
    ```

### Installation with Visual Studio

1. Open your project in **Visual Studio** and select **Project > Manage NuGet Packages**.

1. In the **NuGet Package Manager** page, choose **nuget.org** as the **Package source**.

1. From the **Browse** tab, search for **ITS.Propagation.IF77**, select ITS.Propagation.IF77 in the list, and then select Install as shown in @fig-dotnet-add-nuget.

    ![](/images/dotnet/dotnet-add-nuget.png){#fig-dotnet-add-nuget fig-alt="A screenshot showing the 'NuGet Package Manager'" width=600 fig-align="left"}

1. If you're prompted to verify the installation, select OK.

## Examples

The following code examples show how the IF77 model can be called from .NET project.

### Calling the IF77 Model

```c#
using ITS.Propagation;

// define inputs
var card1 = new IF77.Card1()
{
    d__km = 1.0770273001274191,
    Output = IF77.Output.TransmissionLoss,
    Lobing = IF77.Lobing.NoLobing,
    Percentage = 50,
    TimeAvailability = IF77.TimeAvailability.HourlyMedianLevels
};
var card2 = new IF77.Card2()
{
    Antenna_1_Half_Half_Beamwidth__deg = 0,
    Antenna_1_Pattern = IF77.AntennaPattern.Isotropic,
    Antenna_1_Polarization = IF77.AntennaPolarization.Vertical,
    Antenna_1_Tilt__deg = 0,
    Antenna_1_Use = IF77.AntennaUse.Tracking,
    CounterpoiseDiameter__meter = 0,
    CounterpoiseHeight__meter = 0,
    CounterpoiseMaterial = IF77.Material.None,
    delta_h__meter = 7.3466882206290345,
    d_hzn__km = 1.0770273001274191,
    HorizonInput = IF77.HorizonInput.Height,
    h_1__meter = 829.51898493742192,
    h_fss__meter = 819.51898493742192,
    h_hzn__meter = 820,
    RainfallZone = IF77.RainfallZone.NoRainfall,
    StormSize = IF77.StormSize.FiveKm,
    TerrainType = IF77.TerrainType.IrregularTerrain,
    theta_hzn_degrees = 0,
    theta_hzn_minutes = 0,
    theta_hzn_seconds = 36,
};
var card3 = new IF77.Card3()
{
    Antenna_2_Pattern = IF77.AntennaPattern.Isotropic,
    Antenna_2_Polarization = IF77.AntennaPolarization.Vertical,
    Antenna_2_Tilt__deg = 0,
    Antenna_2_Use = IF77.AntennaUse.Directive,
    Antenna_2_Half_Half_Beamwidth__deg = 0,
    Climate1 = IF77.Climate.AllYearTimeBlock,
    Climate1Weight = 0,
    Climate2 = IF77.Climate.AllYearTimeBlock,
    Climate2Weight = 0,
    EIRP = 0,
    FrequencyScaling = IF77.FrequencyScaling.None,
    f__mhz = 225,
    h_2__meter = 15000,
    h_sur__meter = 821,
    N_0 = 301,
    EarthReflectionMaterial = IF77.Material.AverageGround,
    Scintillation = IF77.Scintillation.IndexGroup0,
    ScintillationUse = IF77.ScintillationUse.NoScintillation,
    WaterState = IF77.WaterState.CalmGlassy,
    WaterTemperature__celsius = IF77.Temperature.TenDegreesCelsius,
    WaterWaveHeight = 0,
    WaterWaveHeightUse = IF77.WaterWaveHeight.UseStandard
};

// Call the IF77 model
var rtn = IF77.IF77Model(card1, card2, card3, out IF77.Result result);

// rtn is 0 (SUCCESS)
// The result is a data structure containing five elements:
// result.warnings                 is 0
// result.takeoff_angle__degrees   is approximately  85.63319
// result.propagation_mode         is ITS.Propagation.IF77.PropagationMode.LightOfSight (PropagationMode enum value 1)
// result.A_fs__db                 is approximately  102.54639
// result.A__db                    is approximately  -102.54841

string msg = IF77.GetReturnStatus(rtn);
// Get Return message: IF77 v1.0 Status: Successful execution

string warning = IF77.GetWarningMessage(result.warnings);
// Get Warning message: No Warnings
```

### Calling the IF77 Extended Model

```c#
using ITS.Propagation;

// define inputs
var card1 = new IF77.Card1()
{
    d__km = 1.0770273001274191,
    Output = IF77.Output.TransmissionLoss,
    Lobing = IF77.Lobing.NoLobing,
    Percentage = 50,
    TimeAvailability = IF77.TimeAvailability.HourlyMedianLevels
};
var card2 = new IF77.Card2()
{
    Antenna_1_Half_Half_Beamwidth__deg = 0,
    Antenna_1_Pattern = IF77.AntennaPattern.Isotropic,
    Antenna_1_Polarization = IF77.AntennaPolarization.Vertical,
    Antenna_1_Tilt__deg = 0,
    Antenna_1_Use = IF77.AntennaUse.Tracking,
    CounterpoiseDiameter__meter = 0,
    CounterpoiseHeight__meter = 0,
    CounterpoiseMaterial = IF77.Material.None,
    delta_h__meter = 7.3466882206290345,
    d_hzn__km = 1.0770273001274191,
    HorizonInput = IF77.HorizonInput.Height,
    h_1__meter = 829.51898493742192,
    h_fss__meter = 819.51898493742192,
    h_hzn__meter = 820,
    RainfallZone = IF77.RainfallZone.NoRainfall,
    StormSize = IF77.StormSize.FiveKm,
    TerrainType = IF77.TerrainType.IrregularTerrain,
    theta_hzn_degrees = 0,
    theta_hzn_minutes = 0,
    theta_hzn_seconds = 36,
};
var card3 = new IF77.Card3()
{
    Antenna_2_Pattern = IF77.AntennaPattern.Isotropic,
    Antenna_2_Polarization = IF77.AntennaPolarization.Vertical,
    Antenna_2_Tilt__deg = 0,
    Antenna_2_Use = IF77.AntennaUse.Directive,
    Antenna_2_Half_Half_Beamwidth__deg = 0,
    Climate1 = IF77.Climate.AllYearTimeBlock,
    Climate1Weight = 0,
    Climate2 = IF77.Climate.AllYearTimeBlock,
    Climate2Weight = 0,
    EIRP = 0,
    FrequencyScaling = IF77.FrequencyScaling.None,
    f__mhz = 225,
    h_2__meter = 15000,
    h_sur__meter = 821,
    N_0 = 301,
    EarthReflectionMaterial = IF77.Material.AverageGround,
    Scintillation = IF77.Scintillation.IndexGroup0,
    ScintillationUse = IF77.ScintillationUse.NoScintillation,
    WaterState = IF77.WaterState.CalmGlassy,
    WaterTemperature__celsius = IF77.Temperature.TenDegreesCelsius,
    WaterWaveHeight = 0,
    WaterWaveHeightUse = IF77.WaterWaveHeight.UseStandard
};

// Call the IF77 extended model
var rtn = IF77.IF77ExModel(card1, card2, card3, out IF77.Result resultEx,
    out IF77.Terminal terminal1, out IF77.Terminal terminal2, out IF77.Path path);

// The terminal1 is a data structure containing terminal 1 information
// The terminal2 is a data structure containing terminal 2 information
// The path is a data structure containing path information
```
